mapper.select:
SELECT BILL_DATE, TXN_TYPE, LOGIC_CARD_NO, TXN_DATE, ORIGINAL_FARE, CUR_STATION_NAME, DEVICE_NO, TICKET_TYPE, TICKET_SUB_TYPE, TIMES, PAY_CHANNEL, ACTIVATE_TIME, QUANTITY, TICKET_TRANS_SEQ, ORDER_NO, ORDER_AMOUNT, ACTUAL_AMOUNT, DISCOUNT_CUMULATIVE_AMOUNT, OVERTIME_AMOUNT, DIFF_SIDE, FAIL_REASON, BATCH_NO, TO_CHAR(CREATE_TIME, 'YYYY-MM-DD HH24:MI:SS') AS CREATE_TIME FROM RECON_TXN_DIFF
ORDER BY BILL_DATE DESC, ID DESC OFFSET #{offset,jdbcType=INTEGER} ROWS FETCH NEXT #{limit,jdbcType=INTEGER} ROWS ONLY

SELECT BILL_DATE, PAYMENT_CHANNEL, PAYMENT_VENDOR, CHANNEL_NAME, CHANNEL_MERCHANT_NO, TERMINAL_NO, BUSINESS_TYPE, TRADE_STATUS, TRADE_TIME, CLEARING_DATE, MERCHANT_ORDER_NO, CHANNEL_TRADE_NO, MERCHANT_REFUND_NO, CHANNEL_REFUND_NO, CURRENCY, ORDER_AMOUNT, TRANSACTION_AMOUNT, FEE_AMOUNT, SETTLEMENT_AMOUNT, DISCOUNT_AMOUNT, PRODUCT_NAME, REMARK, BATCH_NO FROM RECON_THIRD_BILL
ORDER BY BILL_DATE DESC, ID DESC OFFSET #{offset,jdbcType=INTEGER} ROWS FETCH NEXT #{limit,jdbcType=INTEGER} ROWS ONLY

choose.when: SELECT NVL(SUBSTR(PAY_TIME, 12, 2), '--') AS GROUP_KEY, NULL AS PAYMENT_VENDOR, COUNT(1) AS TXN_COUNT, SUM(NVL(AMOUNT, 0)) AS AMOUNT_SUM, SUM(NVL(CASH_AMOUNT, 0)) AS CASH_AMOUNT_SUM, SUM(NVL(COUPON_AMOUNT, 0)) AS COUPON_AMOUNT_SUM, SUM(NVL(REFUND_AMOUNT, 0)) AS REFUND_AMOUNT_SUM FROM PAY_TXN_DETAIL WHERE TXN_DATE = #{txnDateStart,jdbcType=VARCHAR} GROUP BY NVL(SUBSTR(PAY_TIME, 12, 2), '--') ORDER BY GROUP_KEY
choose.otherwise: SELECT TXN_DATE AS GROUP_KEY, PAYMENT_VENDOR, COUNT(1) AS TXN_COUNT, SUM(NVL(AMOUNT, 0)) AS AMOUNT_SUM, SUM(NVL(CASH_AMOUNT, 0)) AS CASH_AMOUNT_SUM, SUM(NVL(COUPON_AMOUNT, 0)) AS COUPON_AMOUNT_SUM, SUM(NVL(REFUND_AMOUNT, 0)) AS REFUND_AMOUNT_SUM FROM PAY_TXN_DETAIL WHERE TXN_DATE >= #{txnDateStart,jdbcType=VARCHAR} AND TXN_DATE <= #{txnDateEnd,jdbcType=VARCHAR} GROUP BY TXN_DATE, PAYMENT_VENDOR ORDER BY TXN_DATE, PAYMENT_VENDOR
